short.en: The Khanna rail disaster takes 212 lives in Khanna, Ludhiana, India.
short.zh: 印度卢迪亚纳州卡纳 (Khanna) 铁路灾难造成 212 人死亡。

short.en: Sixty Ethiopian politicians, aristocrats, military officers, and other persons are executed by the provisional military government.
short.zh: 60 名埃塞俄比亚政界人士、贵族、军官和其他人士被临时军政府处决。

short.en: Albania declares its independence from the Ottoman Empire.
short.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚宣布脱离奥斯曼帝国独立。

short.en: Trunajaya rebellion: After a long and logistically challenging march, the allied Mataram and Dutch troops successfully assault the rebel stronghold of Kediri.
It is the power of the mind to be unconquerable.
A national Thanksgiving Day is observed in the United States as proclaimed by President George Washington at the request of Congress.
A Douglas C-124 Globemaster II crashes into Mount Gannet, Alaska, killing all 52 aboard.
short.zh: 一架道格拉斯 C-124 环球霸王 II 坠毁在阿拉斯加的塘鹅山，机上 52 人全部遇难。

short.en: The Soviet Union makes its final attempt at launching the N1 rocket.
short.zh: 苏联进行了最后一次N1火箭发射尝试。

short.en: Michel Micombero overthrows the monarchy of Burundi and makes himself the first president.
short.zh: 米歇尔·米康贝罗推翻了布隆迪君主制，自立为第一任总统。

short.en: A massive undersea earthquake, estimated magnitude between 8.7 and 9.2, rocks Sumatra, producing a massive tsunami all along the Indonesian coast.
The Manchester Guardian publishes the 1916 secret Sykes-Picot Agreement between the United Kingdom and France.
short.zh: 《曼彻斯特卫报》公布了 1916 年英国和法国之间签署的秘密《赛克斯-皮科协定》。

short.en: Skanderbeg and his forces liberate Kruja in central Albania and raise the Albanian flag.
The Israeli PM says his trial should end after judges said there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases.
short.zh: 以色列总理表示，法官表示三起案件中的一起几乎没有定罪的机会，因此他的审判应该结束。

short.en: If you want to find the secrets of the universe, think in terms of energy, frequency and vibration.
short.zh: 如果你想找到宇宙的秘密，请从能量、频率和振动的角度来思考。

short.en: You should stop worrying about what they say.
short.zh: 你别再管他们说什么了。
short.note: stop doing 停止做；worry about 固定搭配。

short.en: The trial of John Demjanjuk, accused of committing war crimes as a guard at the Nazi Treblinka extermination camp, starts in Jerusalem.
short.zh: 约翰·德米扬纽克 (John Demjanjuk) 被控在纳粹特雷布林卡灭绝营担任看守时犯有战争罪，审判在耶路撒冷开始。

short.en: I don't really care what other people think.
short.zh: 我不太在乎别人怎么想。
short.note: care what 衔接；other people 中 /ð/ 咬舌。

short.en: Casablanca, the movie starring Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman, premieres in New York City.
short.zh: 由亨弗莱·鲍嘉和英格丽·褒曼主演的电影《卡萨布兰卡》在纽约首映。

short.en: The Hollywood A-listers' legal battle focused on the vineyard they bought in 2008 and where they wed six years later.
short.zh: 这对好莱坞一线明星的法律诉讼主要集中在他们 2008 年购买的葡萄园以及六年后他们结婚的地方。

short.en: Jimmie Johnson wins his seventh NASCAR Cup Series championship to tie Richard Petty and Dale Earnhardt for the most all-time.

long.en: Working from home offers more flexibility, but it can also blur the line between work and personal life. Taking short walks, keeping regular hours, and setting aside a quiet workspace help people stay focused and protect their well-being. Small daily habits often matter more than occasional grand efforts.
long.zh: 居家办公带来更多灵活度，但也可能模糊工作与生活的界限。短暂散步、规律作息、留出安静的工作空间，有助于保持专注、维护身心健康。日常小习惯往往比偶尔的大努力更重要。
long.note: 三个动名词主语并列（Taking..., keeping..., setting...）；flexibility 重音在第四音节；well-being 连字符。

long.en: Two Canadian National Railway trains collide in northeastern British Columbia in the Canoe River train crash; the death toll is 21, with 17 of them Canadian troops bound for Korea.

On weekends I usually wake up around eight, make myself a cup of coffee, and sit by the window to plan the day. I like to read for a while, then go for a long walk in the park where I can watch people and dogs passing by.
long.zh: 周末我通常八点左右醒，给自己泡杯咖啡，坐在窗边规划一天。我会先读会儿书，再去公园散步，看行人和小狗经过。
long.note: 按意群在逗号处停顿；where 引导定语从句；passing by 现在分词作伴随。
